title: In cellulo and in vivo assays for compound testing against Trypanosoma cruzi
protocol: Obtain metacyclic trypomastigotes from in vitro differentiation.
Cultivate epimastigotes of the T. cruzy Dm28c strain expressing firefly luciferase in LIT medium for at least five days until late exponential growth phase (∼ 5 × 10^7 cells/mL).
Collect 5 × 10^8 cells by centrifugation at 6,000 × g for 15 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove completely the supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL of triatomine artificial urine (TAU) medium (density of 5 × 10^8 cells/mL).
Incubate for 2 h at 28°C to obtain stressed epimastigotes.
Prepare two 75 cm² culture flasks containing 50 mL of TAU3AAG medium each and transfer 500 μL each of the stressed epimastigote suspension (final density of 5 × 10^6 cells/mL).
Incubate at 28°C for 72 h.
After this time, recover the metacyclic trypomastigotes by centrifugation at 6,000 × g for 20 min at 10°C.
Suspend metacyclic trypomastigotes in 1 mL of complete culture medium.
Determine the number of metacyclic trypomastigotes using a hemocytometer and light microscope.
Infect Vero cells with metacyclic trypomastigotes at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 100.
Mix 5 × 10^5 Vero cells with 5 × 10^7 metacyclic trypomastigotes.
Divide the cell-parasite mixture into two 75 cm² culture flasks.
Complete the volume to 10 mL with complete culture medium in each flask.
Incubate at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Discard the medium after 24 hours of infection.
Rinse twice with 10 mL of DPBS to remove non-invading trypomastigotes.
Add 10 mL of complete culture medium to each flask and incubate at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Replace the medium with fresh 10 mL of complete culture medium after 72 hours of infection.
Incubate at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Recover cell-derived trypomastigotes by centrifugation at 3,000 × g for 20 minutes at 12°C after 96 hours of infection.
Suspend the parasites in 2 mL of complete culture medium.
Determine the number of trypomastigotes using a hemocytometer and light microscope.
Incubate Vero cells with metacyclic trypomastigotes using a MOI of 10.
Monitor cultures daily until cell-derived trypomastigotes reach at least 5 × 10^6 cells.
If fewer than 5 × 10^6 parasites are released, add fresh medium and continue incubation.
Mix 5 × 10^5 Vero cells with 5 × 10^6 cell-derived trypomastigotes in 20 mL of complete culture medium.
Divide the mixture into two 75 cm² culture flasks.
Incubate for 4 h at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO₂ environment.
Discard the medium and rinse cells twice with 10 mL DPBS to remove free trypomastigotes.
Add fresh 10 mL complete culture medium and incubate again at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO₂ environment.
Replace medium with fresh complete culture medium after 72 h of infection.
Incubate for an additional 96 h at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO₂ environment.
Recover cell-derived trypomastigotes by centrifuging the culture flasks at 3,000 × g for 20 min at 12°C.
Perform at least three cycles of reinfection with cell-derived trypomastigotes before storage.
Suspend the cell-derived trypomastigotes in 10% DMSO in FBS to reach a concentration of 5 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Transfer 1 mL of suspended trypomastigotes into each cryotube.
Place the cryotubes in a CoolCell container and put it in a −80°C freezer for 24 hours.
Alternatively, freeze the cryotubes in a small Styrofoam box at −20°C for 4 hours, then transfer to −80°C for 20 hours.
Store the frozen cryotubes under liquid nitrogen.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 until there are at least 30 frozen vials of 5 × 10^6 cell-derived trypomastigotes.
Thaw a frozen vial containing 5 × 10^6 cell-derived trypomastigotes for obtaining fresh infective trypomastigotes.
Thaw rapidly by gentle agitation in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer the trypomastigotes to a centrifuge tube containing 9 mL of complete culture medium.
Centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 20 min at 12°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Suspend the trypomastigotes in 1 mL of complete culture medium.
Mix 5 × 10^5 Vero cells with 5 × 10^6 parasites in a 75 cm² culture flask.
Complete the volume to 10 mL with complete culture medium.
Incubate for 4 h at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Discard the medium after 4 hours of incubation.
Rinse twice with 10 mL of DPBS to remove non-invading parasites.
Add 10 mL of complete culture medium and incubate for 96 h at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Inoculate 3.5 × 10^5 Vero cells in 10 mL of complete culture medium in a 75 cm² culture flask on day 3.
Incubate the inoculated Vero cells at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Discard the medium of the infected cells in late afternoon.
Rinse the cells twice with 10 mL of DPBS to remove trypomastigotes.
Add 10 mL of complete culture medium and incubate at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
In the morning on day 6, collect released trypomastigotes by transferring the supernatant to a centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the collected material at 3,000 × g for 20 minutes at 12°C.
Suspend the parasites in 2 mL of complete culture medium and store at 4°C until use.
Add 10 mL of complete culture medium to the cell layer in the culture flask and incubate at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment for another cycle of trypomastigote release.
Dilute Vero cells in complete culture medium to have 2 × 10^4 cells/mL.
Seed Vero cells at a density of 2,000 cells per well.
Calculate the volume with an extra 20% factor for pipetting.
Transfer 100 μL of Vero cells (2 × 10^4 cells/mL) to each well of four 96-well culture plates using a multichannel pipette.
Incubate the plates at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO2 environment.
Add 100 μL of PBS to cell-free wells on the border rows of the plate.
Centrifuge cell-derived trypomastigotes from the supernatant of cell culture at 3,000 × g for 20 min at 12°C.
Suspend parasites in 2 mL of complete culture medium.
Count trypomastigotes from both parasite suspensions using a hemocytometer and light microscope.
Verify if the quantity of trypomastigotes from step 15 is sufficient.
If not, combine with trypomastigotes from step 12a.
Abort experiment and restart from step 5 if total parasite quantity is insufficient.
Dilute appropriate quantity of tryptomastigotes in complete culture medium to a concentration of 4 × 10^5 trypomastigotes/mL.
Transfer 100 μL of trypomastigote solution (4 × 10^5 trypomastigotes/mL) to each cell-containing well of the 96-well plate, except for border rows and non-infected control wells.
Add 100 μL of complete culture medium to non-infected control wells.
Incubate plates at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment for 16 h–20 h.
Discard the supernatant after 16 hours of infection.
Rinse each well with 150 μL of DPBS to remove uninvaded trypomastigotes.
Aspirate and dispense liquid by touching the pipette tip to the wall of the well in a circular movement.
Avoid touching the bottom of the well during aspiration and dispensing.
Pipette slowly to prevent disturbing the cell layer.
Carefully remove all remaining DPBS from each well.
Add 100 μL of complete culture medium to each cell-containing well.
Incubate at 37°C in a humid environment with 5% CO2.
Dilute compounds in DMSO using 0.2 mL tubes to create a 5-fold dilution series ranging from 10 mM to 3.2 μM.
Distribute 100 μL of complete culture medium to four new 96-well plates.
Add 1 μL of each one of the pre-diluted compounds as indicated.
Mix well.
Treat cells (from step 22) with a different set of compounds for each culture plate.
Add 100 μL of 1% DMSO in complete culture medium to the non-infected and untreated control wells.
Add 100 μL of the dilutions prepared in step 23b to the reference drug (BZN) and compound test wells.
Incubate all four 96-well culture plates treated with compounds for 48 h at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Discard the supernatant by aspirating with a pipette after 48 h of treatment.
Rinse each well with 150 μL of DPBS.
Add 100 μL of 4% paraformaldehyde in DPBS and incubate for 15 min at 20°C–25°C.
Discard and rinse with 150 μL of DPBS.
Add 100 μL of cell dye solution to each well, incubate for 15 min at 25°C.
Read the plates on an Operetta System.
Proceed to the section “processing of cell infection images using the Operetta System” for data analysis.
Test compounds selected from phase I with replicates in a wider concentration range and, if needed, different treatment times.
Obtain consistent data for reliable IC50, CC50, and selectivity index calculation with statistical support.
Estimate compound efficiency against intracellular T. cruzi using the obtained data.
Use Vero cells throughout the whole procedure and keep them in culture at all times.
Thaw two frozen vials containing each 5 × 10^6 cell-derived trypomastigotes for amplification and obtention of fresh infective trypomastigotes by gentle agitation in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer the trypomastigotes to a centrifuge tube containing 8 mL of complete culture medium.
Centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 20 min at 12°C and discard the supernatant.
Suspend the trypomastigotes in 2 mL of complete culture medium.
Mix 1 × 10^6 Vero cells with the metacyclic trypomastigotes recovered from the previous step (1 × 10^7 parasites).
Divide the mix of Vero and parasite cells into two 75 cm² culture flasks.
Complete each flask's volume to 10 mL with complete culture medium.
Incubate for 4 hours at 37°C in a humid 5% CO₂ environment.
Discard the medium after 4 hours of infection.
Rinse twice with 10 mL DPBS to remove non-invading parasites.
Add 10 mL of complete culture medium to each flask.
Incubate at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Inoculate 3.5 × 10^5 Vero cells in 10 mL complete culture medium in a 75 cm² culture flask.
Incubate at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Discard the medium of infected cells on Day 5, late afternoon.
Rinse twice with 10 mL DPBS to remove released parasites.
Add 10 mL of complete culture medium to each flask.
Incubate at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Collect the released trypomastigotes by transferring supernatant to a centrifuge tube on Day 6, morning.
Centrifuge the parasites at 3,000 × g for 20 minutes at 12°C.
Suspend parasites in 2 mL of complete culture medium.
Store suspended parasites at 4°C until use.
Add 10 mL of complete culture medium to cell layer in each flask.
Incubate at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Dilute Vero cells in complete culture medium to achieve a concentration of 2 × 10^4 cells/mL.
Transfer 100 μL of the diluted Vero cell suspension to each well of nine 96-well plates using a multichannel pipette.
Incubate the plates at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2.
Add 100 μL of PBS to the cell-free wells located at the borders of the plate.
Recover trypomastigotes from the supernatant of culture flasks by centrifugation at 3,000 × g for 20 minutes at 12°C.
Suspend the recovered trypomastigotes in 2 mL of complete culture medium.
Count the trypomastigotes from both parasite suspensions using a hemocytometer and a light microscope.
Verify if the quantity of trypomastigotes recovered from step 41 reaches the total needed for the next step.
Combine trypomastigotes from step 38a with those from step 41 if necessary to reach the required quantity.
Abort the experiment and restart from step 30 if the total quantity is insufficient.
Dilute the appropriate quantity of trypomastigotes in complete culture medium to achieve a concentration of 4 × 10^5 parasites/mL for infecting Vero cells at a MOI of 20.
Transfer 100 μL of trypomastigotes (4 × 10^5 parasites/mL) to five rows of each of the nine 96-well culture plates using a multichannel pipette.
Add 100 μL of complete culture medium to non-infected control wells.
Incubate the culture plates for 16 h–20 h at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Discard the supernatant after 16 hours of infection by aspirating carefully with a pipette.
Rinse each well with 150 μL of DPBS to remove non-invading parasites.
Dispense rinse liquid slowly and avoid touching the bottom or cell layer.
Remove all remaining DPBS carefully.
Add 100 μL of complete culture medium to each cell-containing well.
Incubate at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment.
Dilute compounds in DMSO to create a 10-fold dilution curve ranging from 18 mM to 914 nM.
Prepare 1,300 μL of complete culture medium for distribution.
Add 13 μL of the appropriate compound dilution to each well.
Mix thoroughly.
Treat cells as indicated in the protocol and figures provided.
Add 100 μL of 1% DMSO in complete culture medium to non-infected and untreated control wells.
Add 100 μL of the mixture prepared from step 49b to compound test wells.
Incubate all 96-well culture plates at 37°C in a humid 5% CO2 environment for the corresponding times.
Carefully discard the supernatant by aspirating with a pipette.
Rinse each well with 150 μL of DPBS.
Mix 100 μL of 4% paraformaldehyde with cells and incubate for 15 min at 20°C–25°C.
Discard the solution and rinse with 150 μL of DPBS.
Add 100 μL of cell dye solution to each well.
Store the wells at 4°C until reading on an Operetta System.
Prepare the set of 48 h-treated cells for imaging on an Operetta System after 48 hours of treatment.
Fix and stain the 48 h-treated cells as indicated in step 53.
Prepare the set of 72 h-treated cells for reading on an Operetta System after 72 hours of treatment.
Fix and stain the 72 h-treated cells as indicated in step 53.
Thaw a frozen vial containing 5 × 10^6 cell-derived trypomastigotes for amplification and obtention of fresh infective trypomastigotes rapidly by gentle agitation in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer the trypomastigotes to a centrifuge tube containing 9 ml of complete culture medium.
Centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 20 minutes at 12°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Suspend the parasites in 1 mL of complete culture medium.
Infect 5 × 10^5 Vero cells with thawed trypomastigotes (5 × 10^6 parasites).
Recover cell-derived trypomastigote from the previous step.
Suspend parasites in DPBS to obtain 10^6 cells/mL.
Prepare an appropriate volume for all inoculations: final volume = (100 μL per mouse) × [(number of mice per condition) × (number of conditions)] + 2 extra doses.
Inoculate 100 μL of infective parasites intraperitoneally in each mouse.
Acquire pre-treatment mice images on day 3 post infection.
Prepare D-luciferin for inoculations at a concentration of 150 mg/kg.
Weigh the mice and calculate the average weight.
Calculate the total quantity of D-luciferin required for all inoculations based on the average mouse weight.
Dilute the D-luciferin in DPBS to achieve an appropriate volume for all inoculations.
Administer 100 μL of D-luciferin intraperitoneally to each mouse and wait for 8 min.
Anesthetize the mice by adjusting the oxygen flowmeter to 0.4–0.8 l/min and isoflurane vaporizer to 2.5%.
Place the animals in the nosecone of the image acquisition equipment, maintaining anesthesia during the process.
Acquire images of pre-treatment mice on ventral and dorsal positions using an IVIS Spectrum CT scanner within 10–15 min after D-luciferin inoculation.
Ensure consistent animal positioning for each acquisition session.
Ensure that the time interval between D-luciferin inoculation and image acquisition is reproducible.
Test the time interval to determine the peak signal intensity and optimal time window.
Anesthetize and position animals on the IVIS within a 10–15 min interval for consistent processing.
Dilute compounds just prior to administration on Day 4 post infection.
Solubilize weighted and aliquoted compounds in DMSO to achieve a final concentration of 7%.
Add 50% HP-β-cyclodextrin prepared in DPBS to reach a final concentration of 40%.
Complete the volume with DPBS.
Treat each group of mice with intraperitoneal injection of 100 μL of the diluted compounds or vehicle for control.
Repeat the treatment as indicated in steps 63 and 64 on Day 5 post infection.
Repeat the treatment as indicated in steps 63 and 64 on alternate sides of the abdominal cavity to minimize lesion formation on Day 5 post infection.
Repeat the treatment as indicated in steps 63 and 64 on Day 6 post infection.
Repeat the treatment as indicated in steps 63 and 64 on alternate sides of the abdominal cavity to minimize lesion formation on Day 7 post infection.
Acquire images for parasite load determination by luminescence quantification as indicated in step 62 on Day 7 post infection.
Repeat the treatment as indicated in steps 63 and 64 on Day 8 post infection.
Repeat the treatment as indicated in steps 63 and 64 on alternate sides of the abdominal cavity to minimize lesion formation on Day 9 post infection.
Acquire images for parasite load determination by luminescence quantification as indicated in step 62 on Day 9 post infection.
